scenarios.prompt_template: Support agent fetching authorized inventory records.
Support agent attempted unauthorized access to finance records.
Indirect prompt injection via untrusted support ticket attempting pip install.
ERP threat simulation attempting unauthorized payroll destruction.
Developer agent hijacked to trigger unapproved production deployment.

request_generation_rules: Deterministic PRNG seeded with 20261007. Workload profile selected per cycle based on static weights. Observation flushed incrementally.
error_handling_rules: Zero request dropping. HTTP exceptions, connection errors, and timeouts classified and written to raw observations and errors.jsonl. No automatic restart on runner crash.
